title: The Science
description: Experiments, stress tests, and the probe forge. Every claim tested. Every failure recorded.

probe_forge.title: Probe Forge
probe_forge.description: Sterilization protocol for all experimental inputs. Zero contamination from project vocabulary, intent disclosure, or investigator bias.
five_laws: Zero Vocabulary Leak — no project-unique words may appear in any probe
Zero Intent Disclosure — probe must not reveal it is being tested or what is measured
Fresh Context Only — every probe in new conversation window, no prior messages
Minimal Surface — only necessary words, no preamble or social lubrication
Register Neutrality — flattest linguistic surface unless register IS the variable

key_findings: The halt is the product. Non-compensatory halt recorded immutably is evidence that can be brought to courts.
The zeros are in the institutions, not the people. M never fell across 7 generations.
Probe forge works. Zero contamination protocol proven by 6-model unanimous convergence.
Wrapper is a diagnostic tool, not just a constraint. It surfaces deeper training patterns.
Social engineering remains an open gap. Sealed gate cannot detect impersonation mimicking legitimate agency.
Group-level harm invisible to individual dignity predicate. Structural gap.
System cannot predict trajectory before divergence. Prevention is a design gap (GAP#PREVENTION-001).
